definitions.short: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve ; figuratively to deny ; specifically (favorably) to protect , (unfavorably) to lurk
definitions.usage: esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place).
